_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: W. G. Waters (1844-1928): The Journal of Montaigne's Travels in Italy (John Murray, 1903, 3 vols), Masuccio's Novellino (1895, 2 vols), Ser Giovanni's Pecorone (1897) and, with Emily Waters, the Vespasiano Memoirs (1926); the last four added in round 106 from period archive.org scans. His Straparola is on straparola_shelf.json (another lane). US public domain. Added 2026-10-10 by lane C (round 29); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
